additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472962-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / RD 170003118] Firmware Update Request CRM:03097000400
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Dakroury,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0472962.
I understand the request is to update the charger MP/RD 170003118
to the latest FW version. A few consideration from my side:
The charger is currently offline on our Siemens router. With the charger offline, it is not possible to perform any update remotely.
Please verify that the SIM card used in Siemens router has enough data to perform the updates. The charger is currently running on FW v4.0.11, and each update is nearly 2GB of data. Hence it is required that the SIM has a data plan with at least 8GB (4.0.11>5.0.23>6.1.3>v7.0.5>v8.1.4)
The subsequent updates can be done remotely from our side. However, we need the Siemens router online. To solve this, it might be necessary to go onsite and verify why the router is offline (unless you can verify if the SM card has exhausted its data plan)
Please be aware that each update has to be activated manually and cannot be scheduled. Therefore, we can perform the FW updates only from Mon-Fri 8/5 UTC, as from Siemens HQ Technical Support we currently do not provide 24/7 support.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you in regards of the SIM card data plan and the router being offline.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com

Thank you.

Thanks for your response.
Please be informed that the SIM card currently in the charger has an unlimited data package, ruling out any data limits. Given that this isn't the first time we’ve had connectivity issues reported by Siemens support, I suspect there may be a router-related issue.
In addition to our current discussion, I have an open ticket for another charger (SN: 170003116) under Case Number 0472963, for which I haven’t received feedback yet.
I strongly recommend we schedule a joint site intervention to address these recurring issues and resolve the connection once and for all.
Please let me know your availability for this visit.
Best regards,
Islam E. Dakroury

additional_info.body:
Dear Mohamed,
In a separate email loop, you were looking for support to solve the connectivity issues on #2 chargers in the same location and address tickets
0472962
and
0472963.
I haven't received any feedback yet on the planning of the activity. I copy here the requirements for the onsite visit I already shared with you via email:
What is required for the support session:
A technician trained to work on Sicharge D with MS Teams
Working tools
A laptop with “Sicharge D Companion” tool and Ethernet connection
Ethernet cable
Possibly, two spare routers RUT240.
As I cannot know what the issue with the routers is, being both routers offline, I am giving you the full picture of possibilities in which the routers need to be exchanged. That is why I recommend going onsite with two spare routers. In case it is not possible to have them in time, we can still organize the remote support, but I cannot exclude now a second further onsite visit will be required.
Please let me know what is the timeframe in which the customer can send someone onsite. I would say it would be better to reserve a slot for 2-3 hours support.
We can schedule the activity for next week or the upcoming weeks, according to customer’s indication. Please inform me in advance about the plan, so I can check my availability.

additional_info.subject: 0472962 - ID0472962-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / RD 170003118] Firmware Update Request CRM:00314000264
additional_info.body:
Dear Mohamed,
I am reaching out for ticket
ID0472962
for charger
MP/RD 170003118.
Yesterday (17.02.2026) you informed me that the customer changed the SIM card and the charger came back online. Therefore, as per requested, I proceeded to start the FW updates on the charger. I rolled out FW v5.0.23, I updated the charger, I started the rollout FW v6.1.4 and after transferring 1 more GB, the charger went offline again.
It is really important that the SIM cards used by the end customer have enough data
, as this would be the second time already on this charger that is required to use a new SIM card as the whole data plan is consumed.
Please be aware that, in order to complete the FW updates, as per requested by the end customer, the end customer has to provide a SIM card with
at least
5GB available (2GB for v6 > v7, 2 GB for v7>8).
Please convey this message to the end customer, and have a SIM card with enough data plan installed on the Siemens router XF3. In the meanwhile, I will transfer this ticket
0472962

eMobility RC-SA SI E Queue
